caseNameFull: Ellington, Governor of Tennessee v. Blumstein
judges: Are, Denied, Granted, Motion, Should, That

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. M. D. Tenn. Application for stay presented to Mr. Justice Stewart, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice White are of the opinion that the stay should be granted. Motion to advance denied.

Reported below:-F. Supp.-.
